# KGM-M6 input fixtures

- `survey-profile-v1.csv` exercises the version 1 station schema. Values are
  synthetic and use metres, mGal, nT total-field anomaly, and UTC timestamps.
- `base-station-v1.csv` is a synthetic, linearly varying total-field series used
  to verify interpolation and diurnal-change removal.

These small files are test inputs only; they are not field observations.
